dict.string: NotchIsland shows your next meeting in the notch, with a Join button and a reminder 5 minutes before it starts.
NotchIsland shows your next meeting in the notch, with a Join button and a reminder 5 minutes before it starts.
NotchIsland shows a quick mirror in the notch so you can check how you look before a call. Nothing is recorded.
NotchIsland shows a pop-up when your AirPods or other Bluetooth devices connect.
The live visualizer listens to what your Mac is playing so the bars move with the music. Sound is analyzed on your Mac and never recorded or saved.
NotchIsland reads what's playing in Music and Spotify and lets you control playback from the notch.
